name: TC-10-condition-monitoring-types
description: TC-10.2: Condition Monitoring Types — Navigate and view all monitoring types (Vibration, Temperature, Pressure, Oil Analysis, etc.)

doc_metadata.title: TC-10.2 — Condition Monitoring List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Condition Monitoring. The system supports multiple monitoring types: Vibration, Temperature, Pressure, Oil Analysis, Ultrasonic, Thermography, and Current/Voltage.

doc_metadata.title: TC-10.2 — Monitoring Types Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The condition monitoring list shows all monitoring records with their type, current value, threshold levels, and status (Normal, Warning, Critical, Resolved).

doc_metadata.title: TC-10.2 — New Condition Monitoring
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a condition monitoring record. Select the monitoring type, linked asset, and configure baseline, warning, and critical threshold levels.

steps.value: E2E Temperature monitoring — Cooling system outlet

doc_metadata.title: TC-10.2 — Fill Analysis Notes
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Temperature monitoring — Cooling sys" into the Analysis Notes field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-10.2 — Monitoring Record Created
doc_metadata.caption: The monitoring record is created in 'Active' state. Update the current value to trigger threshold-based status changes (Normal → Warning → Critical).

doc_metadata.title: TC-10.2 — Monitoring Detail by Type
doc_metadata.caption: The monitoring detail shows type-specific fields, thresholds, and current readings. Different monitoring types have different measurement units and threshold configurations.
